name: Neo4jEnterpriseCluster Reconciler
description: Reconciles Neo4jEnterpriseCluster CRs into a single {cluster}-server StatefulSet plus Services/ConfigMap/RBAC/TLS, drives rolling upgrades, scale-down drains, and diagnostics, and reports the cluster phase (Initializing to Forming to Ready) via status and events.

name: Neo4jEnterpriseStandalone Reconciler
description: Reconciles Neo4jEnterpriseStandalone CRs into a single-replica StatefulSet plus Service/ConfigMap/Ingress/TLS, folds in Neo4jPlugin-derived neo4j.conf settings, and reports Ready once the StatefulSet has one ready replica.

name: Rolling Upgrade State Machine
description: Drives an image-version upgrade through a requeue-based state machine (Staging to Rolling to Stabilizing to Verifying to Completed) so one reconcile never blocks on a multi-pod rolling restart of the server StatefulSet.

name: Scale-Down Drain Worker
description: Automates the cordon-deallocate-wait-drop drain sequence for servers being removed by a topology shrink, holding StatefulSet replicas via an annotation until every drained server is Dropped or gone.

name: Storage Expansion Worker
description: Detects a spec.storage.size increase, patches the affected PVCs, and orphan-deletes the owning StatefulSet so it is recreated with the enlarged VolumeClaimTemplates, for both cluster and standalone deployments; rejects any shrink attempt outright.

name: Split-Brain Detector
description: Connects individually to each server pod via its headless-service DNS name, compares each pod's SHOW SERVERS view against the largest cluster group, and classifies the cluster as forming, healthy, or split-brain with orphaned pods needing repair.

name: Topology Scheduler
description: Calculates topology-spread and pod anti-affinity placement for the server StatefulSet from spec.topology.placement, auto-discovering availability zones from cluster-scoped Nodes and degrading gracefully in namespace-scoped installs.

name: Live Diagnostics Collector
description: Collects live SHOW SERVERS / SHOW DATABASES / SHOW USERS / SHOW ROLES data from a Ready cluster or standalone instance into status.diagnostics and the ServersHealthy/DatabasesHealthy conditions, never failing the reconcile on a collection error.

name: Neo4jDatabase Controller
description: Reconciler for the Neo4jDatabase CRD: creates/verifies a single logical database (with optional topology and seedURI) against a resolved cluster or standalone, imports initial Cypher data, and drops the database on CR deletion.

name: Neo4jDatabaseAlias Controller
description: Reconciler for the Neo4jDatabaseAlias CRD: creates, retargets, and drops Neo4j database aliases (CREATE/ALTER/DROP ALIAS) against a resolved cluster or standalone.

name: Neo4jShardedDatabase Controller
description: Reconciler for the Neo4jShardedDatabase CRD: issues Cypher 25 CREATE DATABASE ... SET GRAPH SHARD / SET PROPERTY SHARDS, resolves seedBackupRef into per-shard seed URIs, and manages a PVC seed-proxy Deployment/Service for PVC-backed seeds.

name: Neo4jReplicaDatabase Controller
description: Reconciler for the Neo4jReplicaDatabase CRD: creates a cross-cluster replica database from an upstream backup/pull source and, on every pass, re-observes the live `type` column so an out-of-band promotion is detected before any mutating call is issued.

name: Neo4jReplicaPromotion Controller
description: One-shot reconciler for the Neo4jReplicaPromotion CRD: performs the irreversible check-promote-check-record sequence that turns a Neo4jReplicaDatabase into a standalone read-write database.

name: Neo4jBackup Controller
description: Reconciler for the Neo4jBackup CRD: creates exactly one Job per one-time backup CR, or a CronJob for scheduled backups, and parses each backup pod's neo4j-admin log into status.history (invariant: Job-per-CR only, no long-running backup pod/StatefulSet).

name: Neo4jRestore Controller
description: Reconciler for the Neo4jRestore CRD: drives a standalone offline neo4j-admin restore Job, a cluster in-place Cypher dbms.recreateDatabase, or a per-database all-databases restore loop, from a resolved backup artifact.

name: Cluster Reference Resolver
description: Shared helper that resolves a CR's clusterRef to a Neo4jEnterpriseCluster or, failing that, a Neo4jEnterpriseStandalone, and builds the enqueue-on-cluster-status-change watch handler every dependent controller uses.

name: Backup Reference Resolver
description: Shared helper that dereferences a Neo4jBackup CR name into a concrete StorageLocation (with cloud creds folded in) and the per-run BackupsPath of its most recent Succeeded run.

name: Neo4jUser Controller
description: Reconciler for the Neo4jUser CRD: creates/ALTERs the Neo4j user over Bolt, diffs and grants/revokes role membership, and watches Neo4jRole so users stuck on a missing custom role re-reconcile the moment that role lands.

name: Neo4jRole Controller
description: Reconciler for the Neo4jRole CRD: creates the Neo4j role, canonicalises spec.privileges against SHOW ROLE PRIVILEGES AS COMMANDS to diff them, and applies GRANT/DENY statements verbatim while deriving REVOKE statements textually for privileges no longer desired.

name: Neo4jRoleBinding Controller
description: Reconciler for the Neo4jRoleBinding CRD: grants/revokes role membership for a pre-existing, externally provisioned Neo4j user (typically SSO/LDAP first-login) without ever creating or dropping the underlying user.

name: Neo4jAuthRule Controller
description: Reconciler for the Neo4jAuthRule (ABAC) CRD: gates on the cluster running Neo4j 2026.03+ with an OIDC authorization provider configured, then converges the rule's condition/enabled flag and granted-role set via CREATE OR REPLACE AUTH RULE.

name: Neo4j Bolt Client
description: The Bolt-protocol Neo4j client package (internal/neo4j) that issues Cypher against the system database for user, role, privilege, and auth-rule management on behalf of every auth-model controller.

name: Inline Spec Validators
description: Inline spec validators under internal/validation/, one struct per CRD, called synchronously from each reconciler's Reconcile — explicitly NOT a Kubernetes admission webhook, which this project forbids (invariant 1).

name: AuraProviderConfig Reconciler
description: Validates Aura API credentials referenced by an AuraProviderConfig by exchanging them for a token and calling ListInstances, then reports the result on the Ready condition (AuraProviderConfigReconciler).

name: AuraInstance Reconciler
description: Provisions and manages a Neo4j Aura cloud instance via the Aura REST API as a status-poll state machine: idempotent create/adopt (external-name annotation), observe, drift-patch (memory/storage/name/secondariesCount/cdcEnrichmentMode), tier upgrade, pause/resume, and orphan-or-delete on CR deletion (AuraInstanceReconciler).

name: AuraSnapshot Reconciler
description: Requests a one-shot Aura instance snapshot via CreateSnapshot and polls GetSnapshot to a terminal Completed/Failed/Cancelled state; no finalizer since Aura has no snapshot-delete API (AuraSnapshotReconciler).

name: AuraRestore Reconciler
description: Restores an Aura instance in place from a snapshot (by SnapshotID or via an AuraSnapshot CR ref), driving Pending -> Restoring -> Completed/Failed and refusing to re-fire once terminal (AuraRestoreReconciler).

name: AuraCustomerManagedKey Reconciler
description: Registers and manages a customer-managed encryption key with Aura: idempotent create/adopt by matching keyId/region/cloudProvider/instanceType, polls to Ready, and on deletion either orphans (default) or deregisters (refused by the API while any instance still uses the key) (AuraCustomerManagedKeyReconciler).

name: AuraIPFilter Reconciler
description: Manages an organization-scoped Aura network IP filter via the v2beta1 API: idempotent create/adopt by name, resolves spec.instanceRefs to Aura instance IDs for filtered_entities, and converges allow_list/entities/name/filteringDisabled drift (AuraIPFilterReconciler).

name: AuraDatabase Reconciler
description: Manages a database on a multi-database Aura instance via the v2beta1 API: refuses to create when the referenced AuraInstance's probed multiDatabase verdict is explicitly false, and otherwise creates/adopts by the external-database-id annotation since the API returns no database names to adopt by (AuraDatabaseReconciler).

name: AuraDatabaseBackup Reconciler
description: Takes a one-shot on-demand per-database backup via the v2beta1 API and polls it to a terminal Completed/Failed status, never treating an empty just-created status as done (AuraDatabaseBackupReconciler).

name: AuraDatabaseRestore Reconciler
description: Performs a one-shot in-place restore of a database from a per-database backup (by BackupID or AuraDatabaseRestore->AuraDatabaseBackup ref), with a Submitting marker persisted before the destructive call so a crash mid-flight surfaces as RestoreOutcomeUnknown instead of being silently replayed (AuraDatabaseRestoreReconciler).

name: AuraOrganizationMember Reconciler
description: Reconciles the organization role of an existing Aura console user found by email via ListOrgMembers/UpdateOrgMemberRole, and removes membership on CR deletion when deletionPolicy=Delete (AuraOrganizationMemberReconciler).

name: AuraProjectMember Reconciler
description: Reconciles the project role of an existing Aura console user: adds an org-level member to the project via AddProjectMember when not yet a project member, or updates their role, and removes them on CR deletion when deletionPolicy=Delete (AuraProjectMemberReconciler).

name: AuraInvite Reconciler
description: Manages an organization/project invite via the v2beta1 API: builds the two-slot invite body (organization role + optional project role), adopts a matching pending invite by email+project scope, and since there is no GET /invites/{id}, observes status via the LIST endpoint (AuraInviteReconciler).

name: Aura API Client
description: Shared Aura HTTP API client/auth/connection helper: resolves credentials from an AuraProviderConfig or inline Secret, caches one *aura.Client per credential (OAuth token cache + rate-limit budget) keyed by baseURL+clientID+sha256(secret)[:8], and builds the connection Secret/ConfigMap every Aura reconciler that owns a cloud instance writes with the one-time create credentials (aura_common.go, aura_connection.go).

name: Neo4jPlugin Controller
description: Reconciler for the Neo4jPlugin CRD; live-patches NEO4J_PLUGINS via MergeNeo4jPluginList (or injects a checksum-verified init container for installMode=VerifiedDownload) without clobbering env vars owned by other controllers, folds plugin-specific settings into neo4j.conf, and triggers a controlled rolling restart of the target.

name: K8s Resource Builders
description: Builder functions under internal/resources/ that render the desired-state Kubernetes objects (server StatefulSet, Services, NetworkPolicy, MCP sidecar, memory config, resource recommendations) the cluster and standalone reconcilers apply.

name: Operator Manager Bootstrap
description: cmd/main.go: builds the controller-runtime manager, registers every reconciler (devControllerKeys), and exposes the operator's own /metrics, /healthz, and /readyz endpoints.
